def get_nearest_location(self, location: mod_geo.Location) ->Optional[
    NearestLocationData]:
    """ Returns (location, track_no, track_segment_no, track_point_no) for the
    nearest location on map """
    if not self.tracks:
        return None
        
    min_distance = None
    nearest_location_data = None
    
    for track_no, track in enumerate(self.tracks):
        if not track.segments:
            continue
        for segment_no, segment in enumerate(track.segments):
            if not segment.points:
                continue
            for point_no, point in enumerate(segment.points):
                distance = location.distance_2d(point)
                if min_distance is None or distance < min_distance:
                    min_distance = distance
                    nearest_location_data = NearestLocationData(point, track_no, segment_no, point_no)
    
    return nearest_location_data
